◉　Plot

　　After Panor renounces the power of the Three-Eyed God, her life is reset-her memory wiped clean. She
　　begins a new chapter, living her dream of studying at a teacher's college, with Piak quietly watching
　　over and helping her from afar. But peace never lasts long. There are always triggers that threaten to
　　awaken the Three-Eyed God's power inside her, stirred by someone who knows the dark secret she harbors.
　　Remember, "Never awaken the power of the Three-Eyed God." Because Panor will no longer be the Panor you
　　once knew.
